item.title: ALONZE 50EC Abamectin Insecticide
item.description: ALONZE 50EC (Abamectin 50 g/L) is an insecticide, miticide and nematicide with contact and trans-laminar action. It controls spider mites in roses and carnations, thrips and leaf miners in beans, snow peas, broccoli, tomatoes and chilies, and nematodes in potatoes. Rate: 0.15 L/ha in 1000 L water (3 ml per 20 L). Potato nematodes: soil drench 240-300 ml/ha in 1000 L water. Apply at the first signs of pests. Repeat after 7 days, maximum 3 applications. item.title: Rimeta Gold 300SC Fungicide
item.description: Greenlife Rimeta Gold 300SC (carbendazim + pyrimethanil) dual-action systemic and contact fungicide for control of botrytis in roses, and early blight and soft rot in tomatoes and French beans. 1 litre pack; follow the label dose and pre-harvest interval.

item.title: Popvet Total Broad-Spectrum Dewormer for Dogs
item.description: Biodeal Animal Health Popvet Total broad-spectrum dewormer tablets for dogs. Treats and controls roundworms, hookworms, whipworms and all tapeworms, including hydatids. Pack of 4 tablets; dose by body weight as directed on the label.

item.title: Promax 20EC Insecticide
item.description: Promax 20EC public health insecticide for control of cockroaches, bedbugs and ants in homes, hostels, hotels and offices. 1 litre pack; dilute with water and spray cracks, bed frames and corners. Keep away from children, food and pets; read the label before use.

item.title: Rootex 6 Rooting Hormone
item.description: Rootex 6 rooting hormone powder that helps cuttings of roses, carnations and other ornamentals form strong, healthy roots. 50 g tub; dip the cut end of the cutting before planting.

item.title: Kingcode Elite 50EC Insecticide
item.description: Greenlife Kingcode Elite 50EC (lambda-cyhalothrin 15 g/L + acetamiprid 35 g/L) broad-spectrum insecticide for thrips, aphids and whiteflies on roses, French beans, kales, tomatoes and other crops. 1 litre pack; follow the label dose and pre-harvest interval.

item.title: Indoking 300SC Insecticide
item.description: Greenlife Indoking 300SC (indoxacarb 300 g/L) suspension concentrate insecticide for control of bollworms, caterpillars and leaf miners on roses and other crops. 1 litre pack; follow the label dose and pre-harvest interval.

item.title: Icon 10CS Mosquito Insecticide
item.description: Syngenta Icon 10CS (lambda-cyhalothrin 100 g/L) long-lasting residual capsule suspension insecticide for control of public health insects including mosquitoes, flies and cockroaches. 62.5 ml pack; dilute and spray as directed on the label.

item.title: Jembe Star 500SL Herbicide
item.description: Greenlife Jembe Star 500SL (glyphosate 380 g/L + 2,4-D 120 g/L) post-emergence herbicide for control of annual broadleaf weeds and grasses in non-cropped areas. 1 litre pack; avoid spray drift onto crops and read the label before use.

item.title: Jambo Clean Foliar Fertilizer
item.description: Greenlife Jambo Clean foliar fertilizer that cleans sooty mould and honeydew off crops while nourishing them. Contains water-soluble phosphorus pentoxide (P2O5) 8.2% and total nitrogen 10.0% (urea 8.5% + ammoniacal 1.5%). 1 litre pack.

item.title: K-Othrine WG 250 Insecticide
item.description: Bayer K-Othrine WG 250 (deltamethrin 250 g/kg) water-dispersible granules for long-lasting residual control of mosquitoes, cockroaches, bed bugs and flies in public hygiene. 20 g sachet; mix with water and spray as directed on the label.

item.title: Infinito SC 687.5 Fungicide
item.description: Bayer Infinito SC 687.5 (fluopicolide + propamocarb) dual-action suspension concentrate fungicide for downy mildew and blight diseases in roses, tomatoes, potatoes, onions and vegetables. 500 ml pack; follow the label dose and pre-harvest interval.

item.title: Kerol Disinfectant Fluid
item.description: Kerol Disinfectant Fluid (Rideal-Walker coefficient 18-20), a powerful disinfectant and insect repellent for livestock houses, poultry houses and domestic use. 1 litre pack; dilute with water as directed on the label.

item.title: Bat CRP Bat Repellent
item.description: Bat CRP heavy-duty bat repellent chemical for getting rid of bats from roofs, ceilings, halls and other hiding places in homes and buildings. 1 litre pack; dilute with water as directed on the label (roofing and hall areas 1 part product to 4 parts water). Wash hands after use and keep out of reach of children.

item.title: Olvet Drench (Albendazole 2.5% w/v)
item.description: Olvet Drench is an Albendazole 2.5% w/v oral drench for control of liver, stomach and lung worms and tapeworms in cattle, goats and sheep. Suitable for animals of all ages and those in lactation as per label.

item.title: Navigator 100 SC Insecticide
item.description: Navigator 100 SC is an alpha-cypermethrin 100 g/L public health insecticide for control of cockroaches and bed bugs, and as a residual indoor spray against mosquitoes. Keep locked out of reach of children.

item.title: Nilzan Plus Drench
item.description: Nilzan Plus 1 Litre is a combined fluke and roundworm drench for cattle, sheep and goats. Removes bowel tapeworm segments and contains cobalt for improved growth and performance.

item.title: Norbrook Milking Salve
item.description: Norbrook Milking Salve 100 g is a soothing udder and teat ointment containing 0.55% w/w Dichlorophen BP with lanolin as an emollient. Helps prevent chapping and cracking from milking and harsh weather. For animal use only.

item.title: Milestone Extreme 390 SC Fungicide
item.description: Milestone Extreme 390 SC is a dual-action systemic fungicide for control of blight, downy mildew and powdery mildew in crops.

item.title: Levafas Diamond Fluke & Worm Drench
item.description: Levafas Diamond is a double-strength bright yellow suspension of levamisole hydrochloride BP and oxyclozanide. Controls roundworms, lungworms and flukes in cattle, sheep and goats. Follow dosage instructions.

item.title: Maguguma Top 500 SC Herbicide
item.description: Maguguma Top 500 SC is a pre-emergence herbicide (Metolachlor 300 g/L + Atrazine 200 g/L) that prevents new broadleaf weeds and grasses germinating in maize; can also be used as an early post-emergence treatment on newly germinated weeds.

item.title: Livergen Plus Poultry Liver Tonic
item.description: Livergen Plus is an advanced herbal liver protector for use in poultry drinking water. Formulated with plant extracts to support liver health and recovery.

item.title: Maxigrow Zinc & Boron
item.description: Maxigrow Zinc & Boron is a micronutrient foliar feed with Zinc 35% + Boron 25% plus ANAA and other trace elements to boost crop production and quality.

item.title: Mchwatox 350 SC Termiticide
item.description: Mchwatox 350 SC is a suspension concentrate termiticide containing Imidacloprid 350 g/L for control of termites in buildings and construction (pre- and post-construction soil treatment).

item.title: Digester Supper 69 EW Herbicide
item.description: Digester Supper 69 EW (fenoxaprop-p-ethyl 69 g/L) is a post-emergence herbicide for control of annual grass weeds in wheat. 5 litre pack from Greenlife Crop Protection Africa. Read the label before use and keep locked out of reach of children.

item.title: Chariot 500SC Fungicide
item.description: Greenlife Chariot 500SC (carbendazim 500 g/L) is a fungicide for control of botrytis on roses and angular leaf spot on French beans. 1 litre pack. Read the label before use and keep out of reach of children.

item.title: Catapult 480SL Herbicide
item.description: Greenlife Catapult 480SL (glyphosate 480 g/L) is a non-selective post-emergence herbicide for control of annual and perennial weeds before planting maize, French beans and other crops, including under minimum or zero tillage. 1 litre pack.

item.title: Bazooka 18EC Insecticide
item.description: Greenlife Bazooka 18EC (abamectin 18 g/L) is a broad-spectrum miticide and insecticide for control of spider mites and leaf miners on French beans, tomatoes and other crops. 1 litre pack. Read the label before use and keep out of reach of children.

item.title: Compliant 560SC Fungicide
item.description: Greenlife Compliant 560SC (azoxystrobin 60 g/L + chlorothalonil 500 g/L) is a fungicide for powdery and downy mildew on roses, leaf spot, black leg and club root on cabbages, rusts, anthracnose and angular leaf spot on French beans, and coffee berry disease. 1 litre pack.

item.title: Commander 240EC Herbicide
item.description: Greenlife Commander 240EC (oxyfluorfen 240 g/L) is a pre-emergence and early post-emergence herbicide for control of grasses, broadleaf weeds and sedges in onions. 1 litre pack. Read the label before use and keep out of reach of children.

item.title: Ampligo 150ZC Insecticide
item.description: Syngenta Ampligo 150ZC (chlorantraniliprole 100 g/L + lambda-cyhalothrin 50 g/L) is a dual-action insecticide for fall armyworm, bollworm, diamondback moth, cutworms, thrips, aphids and whiteflies. 100 ml pack. WHO Class II; read the label before use.

item.title: Amito 5.7WDG Insecticide
item.description: Amito 5.7WDG (emamectin benzoate) water-dispersible granules for control of fall armyworm, caterpillars and other chewing pests on vegetables and field crops. 1 kg pack. Read the label before use and keep out of reach of children.

item.title: Cropgrow Super Gel Suspension Fertilizer
item.description: CropChem Cropgrow Super Gel is a suspension fertilizer (NPK 24-24-20 + 0.2% MgO) with iron, manganese, boron, copper, zinc and molybdenum trace elements plus bio-stimulants, for use on all crops at all stages. 250 ml pack.

item.title: BioDistinction Extra 700SC Copper Fertilizer
item.description: Greenlife BioDistinction Extra 700SC is a liquid chelated copper suspension concentrate fertilizer (copper oxychloride 700 g/L, 400 g/L metallic copper equivalent) that corrects and prevents copper deficiency in vegetables, fruit, cereals and ornamentals. 1 litre pack.

item.title: Bradley 500SC Fungicide
item.description: Greenlife Bradley 500SC (bitertanol 500 g/L) is a fungicide for control of powdery mildew, rust, anthracnose and Cercospora leaf spot on French beans and other crops. 1 litre pack. Read the label before use and keep out of reach of children.

item.title: Albafas 10% Albendazole Drench
item.description: Albafas is a 10% w/v albendazole worm and fluke drench for cattle, sheep, goats and camels, used against roundworms, lungworms, tapeworms and liver fluke. 500 ml bottle from Norbrook Kenya. For veterinary use; follow the label dose and ask your vet if unsure.

item.title: Beanpro 480SL Herbicide
item.description: Beanpro 480SL is a selective herbicide for control of broadleaf weeds and grasses in bean fields, applied early post-emergence. 1 litre pack. Use a calibrated knapsack sprayer, avoid windy or rainy conditions, and read the label before use.

item.title: Hisense 43A6QKEN 4K UHD Smart TV with TV Guard and Wall Mount
item.description: Hisense 43 inch A6Q 2026 4K UHD Smart TV with a frameless design, 4K AI Upscaler, Dolby Vision and Game Mode PLUS. Comes as a bundle with a TV Guard power protector and a wall mount bracket, ready to install.

item.title: Harman Kardon Onyx Studio 9 Portable Bluetooth Speaker
item.description: Harman Kardon Onyx Studio 9 portable stereo Bluetooth speaker with the rich, room-filling Harman Kardon sound in a sleek round design. Stream wirelessly from your phone or tablet and take the music anywhere in the home.

item.title: Skilltech 44T Tilting TV Wall Mount Bracket
item.description: Skilltech 44T heavy-duty tilting wall mount bracket that fits most 32 to 60 inch TVs. Tilt the screen to cut glare and get the best viewing angle, with a built-in spirit level for a straight install.

item.title: Hisense 7.5kg Twin Tub Washing Machine WSQB753W
item.description: Hisense WSQB753W semi-automatic twin tub washing machine with a 7.5 kg wash capacity. Separate wash and spin tubs let you wash and dry in one go, with a clear lid and easy dial controls. 2 year warranty.

item.title: Hisense REF205DR Double Door Fridge with Water Dispenser
item.description: Hisense REF205DR 205 litre double door fridge in a silver finish with a built-in water dispenser on the door, so you get chilled water without opening the fridge. Energy saving design with a spacious fridge and freezer.

item.title: Vitron HTC4300QFS QLED Android Smart TV with Wall Mount
item.description: Vitron 43 inch QLED Full HD Android smart TV (HTC4300QFS) with built-in WiFi, Bluetooth and DVB tuner, plus YouTube and Netflix apps. HDMI and USB ports included, and it comes with a Skill Tech fixed wall mount.

item.title: TCL 75C6K QD-Mini LED 4K Smart TV
item.description: TCL 75 inch C6K premium QD-Mini LED 4K smart TV with 144Hz Motion Clarity PRO for smooth gaming and sport, an ONKYO 2.1 sound system and Dolby Atmos. A big-screen upgrade with deep contrast and vivid colour.

item.title: Samsung 43U8000F Crystal UHD 4K Smart TV
item.description: Samsung 43 inch Crystal UHD 4K smart TV (43U8000FU, 2025 model) with sharp 4K picture, vivid colour and Samsung smart TV apps built in. A slim, modern design that suits any living room or bedroom.

item.title: Hisense 55A6QKEN 4K UHD Smart TV with TV Guard and Wall Mount
item.description: Hisense 55 inch A6Q 2026 4K UHD Smart TV with a frameless design, 4K AI Upscaler, Dolby Vision and Game Mode PLUS. Comes as a bundle with a TV Guard power protector and a wall mount bracket, ready to install.

item.title: LG LHD657 1000W 5.1 Channel Home Theatre System
item.description: LG LHD657 home theatre with 1000W of power and 5.1 channel surround sound. Four tall floor-standing speakers, a centre speaker and a powered subwoofer fill the room with cinema-style sound for movies, music and sport.
